metadata.description: OMNIcode plugins — substrate-native code tools (verified synthesis, content-addressing, self-improvement).

plugins.name: substrate-synth
plugins.description: Verified, address-grounded code synthesis — the substrate address→generate→VERIFY→accept loop. Nothing invalid is ever accepted. Ships a skill teaching the loop, the in-core OMC builtins (gen_omc, fn_swap_verified, @memo, ...), and the codebase-agnostic scaffold.
